newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Champion Tech in unit spin off plan.
newsitem.headline: Champion Tech in unit spin off plan.

text.p: Champion Technology Holdings Ltd said on Friday it plans to spin off its radio communications unit following a proposed group reorganisation.

It proposed to transfer the interests held by Champion in various subsidiaries engaged in the desgin, manufacture, distribution and leasing of radio communications systems and equipment to a subsidiary of Champion, the company said in a statement.
Application has been made to the Stock Exchagne of Hong Kong for a listing of the subsidiary on the stock exchange, Champion said but it did not give the name of the subsidiary.
Further announcement would be made as soon as there were new developments relating to the proposed listing, the company said.
